The '''Pirate's Sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|850}} after reaching floor 25 in [[The Mines]]. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 50 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Level lowered from 4 to 2 and sell price lowered from {{Price|200}} to {{Price|100}}. Added as a possible reward on floor 50 in the remixed Mines.}}
